captions.detailed: This is a commercial bar blender consisting of a matte black rectangular base housing, a semi-transparent blue polycarbonate blending jar, and a hinged sound-enclosure lid. On the front face of the black housing, there is an orange safety lock latch mounted on a silver panel. The lid is attached to the upper rim of the jar with a revolute hinge, allowing it to swing open, and the base features a four-blade cross assembly on a revolute joint inside the bottom of the jar.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a commercial bar blender with a black rectangular housing, an orange front-panel safety latch, and a semi-transparent blue polycarbonate jar. The jar should feature a hinged sound-enclosure lid on a revolute joint at its top rim, and a rotating four-blade cross assembly at its bottom base.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blender by defining several parts. The base housing is created using a Box primitive, with a front panel and an orange latch attached. The jar is modeled as a hollowed-out tapered box using custom loft or extruded shapes with a semi-transparent blue material. The lid is defined as a thin rectangular plate with side flanges and hinge knuckles, connected to the jar top via a revolute joint. The blade assembly inside the jar is modeled with intersecting thin boxes representing the four cross blades, mounted on a central cylindrical pin with a continuous/revolute joint.
